armyRules.name: Thrill Seekers
armyRules.effect: Units are eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which they Advanced or Fell Back, but cannot target a unit they were within Engagement Range of at the start of the turn, nor a unit already targeted by another unit's charge or attack this phase.

armyRules.name: Pact of Excess
armyRules.effect: Unless stated otherwise, you cannot select LEGIONS OF EXCESS as your Army Faction.

battleFormations.name: Mercurial Host
battleFormations.effect: Quicksilver Grace: Re-roll Advance rolls made for Emperor's Children units.

battleFormations.name: Peerless Bladesmen
battleFormations.effect: Exquisite Swordsmanship: If a unit made a Charge move this turn, select [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] for its melee weapons that Fight phase.

battleFormations.name: Rapid Evisceration
battleFormations.effect: Mechanised Murder: Attacks made by Transport models or models that disembarked this turn re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

battleFormations.name: Carnival of Excess
battleFormations.effect: Daemonic Empowerment: Emperor's Children and Legions of Excess units within 6" of each other are 'Empowered' — their weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (or score Critical Hits on 5+ if already having that ability). Can include Legions of Excess up to 500/1000/1500pts by battle size; cannot be Warlord.

battleFormations.name: Coterie of the Conceited
battleFormations.effect: Pledges to the Dark Prince: At the start of the battle round, if your Warlord is on the battlefield, pledge a number of enemy units to destroy. Meet it to gain Pact points equal to the pledge (fail = Warlord suffers D3 mortal wounds). Pact points grant cumulative army-wide bonuses: 1+ re-roll Hit 1s, 3+ re-roll Wound 1s, 5+ melee gains [LETHAL HITS]+[SUSTAINED HITS 1], 7+ Critical Hit on unmodified 5+.

artefacts.name: Steeped in Suffering
artefacts.effect: [EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only] +1 Hit vs below-strength targets; +1 Wound as well vs Below Half-strength targets.

artefacts.name: Intoxicating Musk
artefacts.effect: [EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only] Melee attacks with Strength greater than the bearer's unit's Toughness suffer -1 to Wound.

artefacts.name: Tactical Perfection
artefacts.effect: [EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only] After deployment, redeploy up to 2 units, any to Strategic Reserves.

artefacts.name: Loathsome Dexterity
artefacts.effect: [EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only] The bearer's unit can move through enemy models (not ending within Engagement Range); Desperate Escape auto-passes.

artefacts.name: Faultless Opportunist
artefacts.effect: [EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only] Target with Heroic Intervention for -1CP regardless of prior uses that phase.

artefacts.name: Blinding Speed
artefacts.effect: [EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only] Once per battle, the bearer's unit gains Fights First for the phase.

artefacts.name: Distortion
artefacts.effect: [EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only] +1 Attacks/Damage on the bearer's melee weapons.

artefacts.name: Rise to the Challenge
artefacts.effect: [EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only] Once per battle, if engaged with 3+ enemy models at end of Fight phase, fight one additional time.

artefacts.name: Sublime Prescience
artefacts.effect: [EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only] Once per turn, treat a Transport in Strategic Reserves as arriving one round later for setup purposes.

artefacts.name: Spearhead Striker
artefacts.effect: [EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only] After disembarking, re-roll Charge rolls; enemies cannot use Fire Overwatch against the bearer's unit that turn.

artefacts.name: Accomplished Tactician
artefacts.effect: [EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only] Once per turn, after being shot, a nearby hit unit can embark into a nearby Transport.

artefacts.name: Heretek Adept
artefacts.effect: [EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only] Once per battle round, change a failed save's Damage to 0 for a nearby friendly Vehicle.

artefacts.name: Empyric Suffusion
artefacts.effect: [EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only] Heroic Intervention targeting this unit costs -1CP.

artefacts.name: Dark Blessings
artefacts.effect: [EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY model only] Once per battle, gain a 3+ invulnerable save for a phase.

artefacts.name: Possessed Blade
artefacts.effect: [EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only] +1 Attacks on a chosen melee weapon; when fighting, +1 Damage and gains [DEVASTATING WOUNDS]/[HAZARDOUS].

artefacts.name: Warp Walker
artefacts.effect: [EMPEROR'S CHILDREN or KEEPER OF SECRETS model only] Advances without a roll (+6" Move); can move through enemy models without ending within Engagement Range.

artefacts.name: Pledge of Eternal Servitude
artefacts.effect: [EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only] First destruction: Leadership test to return with D6 wounds.

artefacts.name: Pledge of Dark Glory
artefacts.effect: [EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only] While leading a unit, +1 Leadership/Objective Control for that unit.

artefacts.name: Pledge of Mortal Pain
artefacts.effect: [EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only] At the start of your Shooting phase, force a nearby Leadership test; on failure inflict 3 mortal wounds.

artefacts.name: Pledge of Unholy Fortune
artefacts.effect: [EMPEROR'S CHILDREN model only] Once per turn, treat a Hit/Wound/Save roll as an unmodified 6 if not Battle-shocked.
